title: Fugitive Telemetry
author: Martha Wells
summary: A short novel in a series about a security android that has freed itself from corporate control and would mostly rather watch its serials. When a body turns up on a station, it ends up investigating.
readIf: you like a sardonic, socially awkward narrator in a quick murder mystery set in space.
skipIf: you want to start the series at the beginning, since the cast arrives with history.

pairings.reason: Shares the dry, deflating humour and a far-future setting that never takes itself too seriously.
A cosy, funny investigation led by unlikely sleuths rather than an android.
A warmer, found-family take on life aboard ships and stations among mixed species.
